text.tspan: BVLOS SAFETY ACADEMY · CONOPS AND OPERATIONS MANUAL FOR BVLOS
Twelve sections and the people who read them
does it match the approval requested?
can the service be delivered on site?
what can go wrong, what controls exist?
what is the mission, what is out of scope?
where and when will it fly?
Every sentence should trace to a decision, a number or a limit.
Checklists belong in the Operations Manual, not in the ConOps.
Training material. Not approved by any authority.
